snippet.title: DE:VOID Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist on
Steam : http://bit.ly/devoidsteam
Itch.io : http://bit.ly/devoiditchio
Discord : https://discord.gg/2JJcngz

A side-scrolling horror game which explores the themes of life and death in a unique way. Help a girl find her memories and escape from a mysterious world. 

Mature Content Description
This game contains themes/depictions of death and suicide. Also contains several visual glitch effects. Not recommended for people who have epilepsy or are sensitive toward disturbing contents.
